summary: R15 P0 CLOSED. Verified end-to-end that the new booking-detail fields (needs_forklift, needs_loading_help, dimensions_l_m/w_m/h_m, volume_m3, item_count) round-trip through POST /api/jobs and render as JobExtras chips on all three role views. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_final_qa_r15.py PASS — (1) fixed-price POST returns all 7 fields with exact values, (2) minimal POST (only weight_kg) still 200 with needs_forklift=false / needs_loading_help=false defaults and dim/item fields None, (3) bidding-type POST (pricing_type='bidding', max_budget=300) accepts + round-trips the same fields, (4) /api/jobs/mine echoes them for the customer, (5) /api/admin/jobs/{id} echoes them for the admin. Frontend (Playwright, 1400x900): posted a fresh fixed job (314fa129) and a fresh bidding job (c9a26fd4) via direct API (main-agent-sanctioned since wizard drives Google Places). On /customer/job/:id BOTH jobs render all 6 chips: jobextras-forklift, jobextras-loading, jobextras-weight (250 kg), jobextras-items (4 items), jobextras-dims (2m × 1.2m × 1.5m L·W·H), jobextras-vehicle (Luton Van). Driver /driver/job/314fa129 renders identical 6-chip 'Booking details' row (below the 'Before you accept' Suitable Vehicle card). Admin /admin/jobs → search 'R15 QA fixed' → row click opens data-testid='admin-job-modal' which renders JobExtras with identical 6 chips. Regression: R13 baseline pytest still 7/7 pass unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: JobCreate now declares dimensions_l_m/w_m/h_m, volume_m3, item_count, needs_forklift, needs_loading_help with sensible optional defaults (bools default False, numerics default None) — clean Pydantic contract. Backward compatible: minimal POST test confirms existing UK clients still work.
PostJob.jsx submit() body now forwards the same seven keys the wizard already captured in local state — root cause (silent boundary drop) fully mitigated at both endpoints.

JobExtras.jsx is a pure render (no state, no effects) and correctly guards each chip on truthy field presence — the same component instance is reused across customer/driver/admin, so parity is guaranteed by construction. No duplication in surfaces.

Round-trip is uniform: server persists exactly the keys posted and every read endpoint (/jobs/mine, /admin/jobs/{id}, driver GET) echoes them back — no read-side mapping layer to keep in sync, which prevents future field-drop regressions.
Nit (non-blocking, pre-existing R14): the two useNotificationChime instances still co-exist on Dashboard + Messages; unchanged this round.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 chips visible on customer-fixed, customer-bidding, driver, admin-modal)

context_for_next_testing_agent: R15 fix is fully closed. Pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_final_qa_r15.py is the canonical regression for the JobCreate boundary contract — run it whenever JobCreate or /api/jobs handler shape is touched. All three role UIs (customer, driver, admin-modal) share JobExtras.jsx so a single chip render check against a freshly-posted job is enough. Wizard-driven Playwright was skipped in favour of direct API POST because Google Places autocomplete is fragile in headless — main agent explicitly permitted this in the R15 note.
rca of the issue: Fix was symmetric on both sides of the boundary: (i) backend JobCreate Pydantic model was widened to declare the seven new optional fields (server.py L282-293) so Pydantic no longer discards them, and (ii) frontend PostJob.jsx submit() body was widened to forward the same keys from wizard state (L218-240). Verified by (a) direct curl-style pytest that round-trips all seven values through POST → GET, and (b) Playwright chip render check on customer/driver/admin views of two freshly-posted jobs. Historic jobs missing these fields legitimately do not render the chips — that is not a regression.
